newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank keeps Swedish repo unchanged at 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank keeps Swedish repo unchanged at 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a one-week repurchase rate at a fixed, unchanged 4.10 percent.
The reverse repurchase operation will run from March 5 to March 12.
The decision was in line with expectations with a Reuter poll of eleven analysts showing ten expected the Riksbank to leave the repo unchanged.
Analysts said the Riksbank was likely to wait for the crown to strengthen before cutting further or wait until it presents its inflation report on March 20.
The Riksbank has not cut the repo since December 17, 1996.
The repo rate, the bank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity, was cut to its current level of 4.10 percent from 8.91 percent at the beginning of 1996.
